description:
Cast Raven's Crime from your graveyard by paying {B} and discarding Dakmor Salvage, targeting any player.
Bone Miser's second ability and Moonveil Regent's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Moonveil Regent trigger, causing you to discard your hand, then mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Raven's Crime, causing target player to discard a card.
Repeat.
